limits: All fixture observations are invented development data. The preflight checks consistency of declared times and load IDs, not physical sample identity or authenticity of evidence.
A declarant can relabel a borrowed source; external custody, records, measurements and competent review remain necessary.
The script does not calculate V or G and does not establish field impact or criterion 3.
